Research Impact & Citations

My research has been cited by researchers worldwide and has contributed to advancing the field of AI in construction safety. Key impact areas include:

  • Computer Vision: Novel approaches to low-light image enhancement and fisheye lens processing
  • Construction Safety: Automated hazard detection and safety monitoring systems
  • AI Integration: Combining vision-language models with domain-specific knowledge
  • Industry Applications: Real-world deployment of AI solutions in construction environments
